title: Claim card
description: A first-class unit of knowledge state (PLAN §2/§8, Q8). 'What's true right now?' = the set of cards with status 'live'. Corrections are POINTERS, not rewrites: a refutation flips `status` and adds a `superseded_by` edge rather than editing the statement. A substrate version bump auto-flips every dependent card to 'needs_replication' via the `depends_on` edge. Two decks share this schema, discriminated by `deck`: research claims (refuted by experiments) and working-preferences (change when you change your mind).

id.description: claim_<kebab-slug>. Stable; superseding/superseded edges reference it.

deck.description: research = an empirical claim refutable by experiment (stored under claims/research/). preference = a working-preference / how-to-work rule that changes only when YOU change your mind (claims/preferences/). PLAN §2 'two separate decks'.

statement.description: The claim, stated so its truth value is checkable. Include the scope qualifier in the prose when load-bearing (e.g. 'on seed 119', 'cohort n=100').

supporting_runs.description: Run ids whose evidence supports the claim. Referential: each must resolve to a run_record. Empty is normal for preference-deck cards.

refuting_runs.description: Run ids whose evidence refutes the claim. A non-empty list on a 'live' card is a contradiction the claim-consolidate skill should surface.

confidence.description: Ordinal confidence. The calibration skill tunes the mapping to measured hit-rate; it does not replace this field.

gates_passed.description: Gate ids passed by the supporting evidence (union or strongest run). Same vocab as run_record.gates_passed.

oracle_clean.description: True iff every supporting run is oracle_clean. A claim resting on an oracle-tainted run is NOT oracle_clean and must not be cited as blind-pipeline evidence (the s058/s059 retraction rule).

calibrated_hit_rate.description: Optional. Filled by the calibration skill: empirical fraction of past claims at this confidence band that held up.

scope.description: The N-scope gate enforces consistency: kind='cohort' requires N >= threshold (config), else auto-downgrade to N1.

items.description: substrate-ref string 'component@version' (grammar in README). Must resolve to a substrate_component id + a version in its history.

depends_on.description: The substrate versions this claim's evidence rests on (Q8). THE blast-radius edge: when component bumps past the cited version, this card auto-flips to needs_replication.

status.description: Lifecycle. draft = auto-drafted, awaiting human confirm (Q8 §8). live = current truth. needs_replication = a substrate bump invalidated the evidence (auto-set by blast-radius). superseded = a newer card replaces it (see superseded_by). retracted = withdrawn (e.g. oracle taint discovered, structurally false). PLAN §2 names live|superseded|needs_replication; draft/retracted are the lifecycle endpoints §8 implies — see README 'Deviations'.

superseded_by.description: Id of the claim that replaces this one. Set together with status='superseded'. The correction is this pointer, not an edit to `statement`.

supersedes.description: Back-edge: id of the claim this one replaces (optional convenience for the index).

links_to_writeups.description: Paths to prose writeups / memory files behind the claim.

confirmed_by.description: Who promoted draft->live (e.g. 'girish'). Absent while status='draft'.

updated_at.description: Last status/edge change. Claim FIELDS other than status/edges should rarely change (corrections are new cards).
